newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Envestra to raise A$910 million.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Envestra to raise A$910 million.

text.p: Boral Ltd's gas distribition spinoff, Envestra Ltd, said on Tuesday it planned to raise A$910 million through the issue of A$350 million of stapled equity securities, A$345 million in term debt, and A$215 million in capital indexed bonds.
Envestra said it was offering 350 million of stapled securities at A$1.00 each, with each stapled security comprising one loan note and one share in Envestra.
The loan note and shares will only be able to be sold together and cannot be sold or dealt separately.
The stapled securities have a forecast distribution rate of 7.75 percent in the year to June 30, 1998, 8.15 percent in 1998/99 and 8.55 percent in 1999/00.

The A$910 million raised will be used to buy Boral Ltd's South Australia, Queensland and Northern Territory natural gas distribution networks for a total consideration, including transaction costs, of A$910 million.
On July 1, Boral said it would be paid A$889 million by Envestra for the gas network assets, yielding net proceeds from the sale of about A$840 million.

The A$910 million paid includes A$889 million to buy the networks, A$5 million in stamp duty, and A$16 million in transaction costs. Envestra said Boral would buy 19.97 percent of the stapled securities and Boral shareholders would be offered a priority allocation of 60 percent of the securities.
Envestra said the offer would open on July 28 and was expected to close on August 15.
The securities were expected to start trading on the Australian Stock Exchange on August 27, it said.
